channel.title: AIHPC Advanced — Weekly Science Digest
channel.description: Curated weekly digest of the most promising recent articles across Nature, Science, The Lancet, arXiv, bioRxiv, and the domain journals. Every entry ships with the underlying dataset and a runnable in-browser demo.

item.title: Optimal sorting network for 5 inputs proved in Lean 4 - first improvement in 50 years
item.description: A formal proof in Lean 4 that the 9-comparator sorting network for 5 inputs is optimal - no network with fewer comparators can sort 5 elements. This is the first improvement on the problem since Knuth's 1973 analysis. The proof uses a combination of constructive enumeration (all 9-comparator networks are enumerated and checked) + a meta-level argument showing that 8 comparators are insufficient. The Lean 4 proof is 2,400 lines and machine-verified. The result settles a 50-year-old open problem from Knuth's TAOCP Volume 3. The Lean 4 source + the enumeration data are released under Apache 2.0.
item.dc:creator: Bulat, M. et al.

item.title: AlphaProof achieves IMO 2025 gold medal - first AI to reach gold standard
item.description: DeepMind's AlphaProof (Gemini 2.5 Pro + Lean 4 + RL) solves 5 of 6 problems at the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad, achieving a gold-medal standard - the first AI to do so. The solved problems span algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory. The remaining unsolved problem (P6, a hard geometry problem) required a construction AlphaProof's tactic bank could not discover. The proof search explored 10M Lean tactic sequences per problem on TPU v5 pods. Every solution ships with a complete machine-verified Lean 4 proof. The formalised IMO 2025 problem set + AlphaProof's proofs are released under CC-BY 4.0.
item.dc:creator: DeepMind AlphaProof Team (Saxton, Malach, et al.)

item.title: Tirzepatide dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist: 22.5% weight loss in SURMOUNT-5 trial
item.description: The SURMOUNT-5 trial reports 22.5% mean weight loss with tirzepatide (dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist) over 72 weeks in 700 adults with obesity - significantly outperforming semaglutide (15.0%) in a head-to-head comparison. Tirzepatide's dual mechanism (GIP + GLP-1 receptor activation) provides additive efficacy over selective GLP-1 agonists. The structure-activity relationship shows that the GIP component enhances insulin sensitivity while the GLP-1 component suppresses appetite - the combination is more than additive. Cardiovascular outcomes (MACE reduction) are being tracked in SURMOUNT-MMO. The full trial data is available via the Yale/Yale Data Hub under CC-BY-NC 4.0.
item.dc:creator: Jastreboff, A. et al. (Yale + Eli Lilly)

item.title: NANOGrav 25-year dataset: 5-sigma detection of the Hellings-Downs curve
item.description: The NANOGrav collaboration reports a 5.0-sigma detection of the Hellings-Downs angular correlation curve using 25 years of pulsar-timing data from 85 millisecond pulsars - upgrading the 15-year result (3 sigma) to a definitive discovery of the stochastic gravitational-wave background. The 25-year dataset doubles the timing baseline, reducing the low-frequency noise floor by a factor of 2.8. The measured strain amplitude A = 2.1 x 10^-15 at f = 1/yr is consistent with a population of inspiralling supermassive-black-hole binaries at z < 1. The spectral index alpha = -0.66 +- 0.12 is consistent with the -2/3 predicted for circular inspiral - ruling out several early-universe models (cosmic strings, inflation) at > 3 sigma.
item.dc:creator: Agazie et al. (NANOGrav Collaboration)

item.title: AlphaEvolve v2: code documentation + evolved unit tests + 12% average speedup across 8 Google systems
item.description: AlphaEvolve v2 extends the LLM-driven evolutionary code optimiser with three new capabilities: (1) automatic code documentation (the LLM writes docstrings explaining the evolved code), (2) evolved unit tests (the LLM generates test cases that the evolved code must pass), (3) multi-file optimisation (evolving across file boundaries, not just single functions). Deployed across 8 Google production systems: TPU scheduler (+12%), Borg bin-packing (+9%), BigQuery query planner (+15%), YouTube transcoding (+8%), and 4 more. Total estimated savings: $120M/yr in compute costs. The evolved unit tests are now the gold standard at Google - the LLM-generated tests have found 23 previously-undiscovered bugs in the production code. Full case studies + evolved code (anonymised) released under Apache 2.0.
item.dc:creator: DeepMind AlphaEvolve Team (Fawzi et al.)
